board.title: My LCA · K · Events you direct, rows with the next step (round 2)

drawn.title: My LCA · K · Events you direct, rows with the next step (round 2)
drawn.second_title: My LCA · K-2 · Events you direct: the role, the phone and the way back (round 2)
drawn.note:
What: Option K for Events you direct in My LCA. Each event is one dense row in date order, and on the day the live event is pinned first. A row shows status, counts, flags and the next step in words ("Next: publish the prize list · Setup 6 of 10"). One-tap decisions sit inline: Approve or Decline a bye, Email both a reminder, Email him the renewal link. Setup, Event day, Recap and Rating report show only when they apply. Frame A is Chris on Mon, Oct 5, 8:10 AM. Frame B is Sun, Oct 25, 11:15 AM, with round 3 live. Part 2 (K-2) has the tournament_director role with no events and its one lookup line, the phone, and the rail and menu rows. It also has the way in and back under Int-A, B and C, with Exit console.

Built from: Account-C's Events you direct, Work-A's console and Reported results queue, Work-D's setup checklist (10 steps per WS08), and replan 4.6's close-out, rating report and Recap. Chrome is the decided header and My LCA menu (Nav-Header-Final). The board is drawn inside Int-A, and the frame is swappable.

K's feedback applied: roles live in My LCA, not Workspace or the admin panel. A plain member never sees this section, and a one-event director sees rows and rooms but no lookup. The section is drawn busy, live, empty and on a phone. Option L is the card version with a stage track. Open for K: rows (K) or stage cards (L); keep tournament_director as "a director who can also look up members" or fold it into assignments plus lca_auditor; may a standing TD start a draft for review (drawn: no).

board.title: My LCA · L · Events you direct, a stage track per event (round 2)
board.name: Events you direct, a stage track per event
board.idea: Each event is a card with a five-stage track (Set up · Registration · Event day · Close out · Rating report) showing where it is in its life, with the current stage's work and buttons under the track.
board.differs: Account-K lists events as dense rows with the next step as a sentence; Account-L gives each event a card with a five-stage track so a director sees at a glance which stage each event is in.

drawn.title: My LCA · L · Events you direct, a stage track per event (round 2)
drawn.second_title: My LCA · L · Events you direct, a stage track per event (round 2) · part 2
drawn.note:
What: Option L for Events you direct in My LCA. Each event Chris is named on is a card with the same five-stage track (Set up · Registration · Event day · Close out · Rating report). Gold marks the current stage, navy marks a done stage, and an amber dot marks a done stage that still has work. Every node also says its state in words. The panel under the track holds only the current stage's work and its one-tap decisions. Part 1 is Frame A, Mon, Oct 5, with the three events at three stages. Part 2 has Frame B (Sun, Oct 25, round 3 live), Frame C (the tournament_director role with no events), Frame D (phone) and Frame E (the rail row, the menu row, the crumbs under Int-A, B and C, and the console band with Exit console).

Built from: Account-C's Events you direct (counts by section, flags, the bye decision, the reminder email, the rating report check); Work-D's 10 setup steps; Work-A and replan 4.6 for the results queue, close-out and rating report; Nav-Header-Final for the signed-in header, live strip and My LCA menu. The events and figures are the same as Account-K, so choosing between K and L changes no data.

K's feedback applied and open for K: a plain member never sees this section; it appears only with a director assignment. The director's work is hosted in My LCA and opens its rooms (Setup, Event day, Recap, Rating report) from here, never through the admin panel, and the word Workspace is gone. The board is drawn inside Int-A and the frame is swappable. Open for K: K (rows) or L (track); the frame (Int-A, B or C); directors named only, with no create button; keep or fold the tournament_director role; the hub pins the live event but never becomes the console.

Account-L-2.dc.html (2950) has Frames B, C, D and E with the same title strip and legend, plus a one-line pointer to the grey note on part 1.

review.counts: Main board: 1440 wide, natural height 2941px, declared 2950 (under 3000). Part 2: natural height 1956px, so the declared height went from 1950 (which clipped 6px) to 2000. No element overflows or clips on either board, and every tag is balanced. Six numbered notes on each legend. Main board regions: title strip (Built from, Replaces, Shown, Differs, Frame, K's feedback applied, Sample data), grey note (What, Built from, K's feedback applied, three Open for K), the decided signed-in header with My LCA and count 1, the page head with the five role chips, "Role looks wrong?" and "Show my card" (no Workspace button), the On this page rail (Today 9, You, Family 1, Events you direct 3, Your region 4, Board 7 current), Today across your roles (seven ranked rows with worded labels, "9 things · 1 is yours", Show 2 more), four collapsed sections, then the Board section. That section has its head (term ends Wed, Jun 30, 2027), Open board inbox, Governance documents, a 3-row Treasurer inbox, the South Central Louisiana inbox line, the next meeting (Tue, Nov 10 · 7:00 PM, Add to calendar), the documents card, and an LCA office half with Support tickets, Documents you keep, Members (312, "300+ members" kept), and the lookup (Avery Thibodeaux, name, status and end date only). Footer is identical to Tourn-List-Final. Part 2: Empty, Busy (6 rows, two flagged in words on amber), President (Email the members room), Secretary (Post minutes plus its Today row), the rail row, the My LCA menu (Board inbox (3) and Support tickets (4) ringed, no Workspace or Admin or Member lookup row), breadcrumbs under Int-A, B and C for five rooms, the room band with Back to My LCA, and the About › Minutes edit-in-place strip. Copy scan: every date has its weekday, times are written like 7:00 PM, there are no em dashes, no USCF, no stray .5 in copy, no AI references, no grade, birthdate or financial-need question, and gold is never used as text colour. Invented data carries Sample badges.
